text:
Lina (CSM): PulseWave QBR prep — onboarding still ~70% done, token burn is ~+30% vs forecast over last 7d. Need to align on spend forecast + budget alerts before the deck.
Evan (Finance): pulling the numbers now. do we have a 30d projection with current ramp?
Sam (SRE): I can export per-route usage histogram. Where should we store the forecast snapshot?
BudgetBot: Automated spend alert: pulsewave-prod hit 78% of committed credits at 2026-03-10T09:12Z.
Evan (Finance): 30d w/ current growth => projected spend $19.2k, commit $15k => gap ~$4.2k. Token-econ note: effective tokens/$ down ~12% due to embedding-heavy traffic.
Lina (CSM): Not great. Proposal: temporary throttle on embedding route + immediate enablement session for their infra + capture feedback on docs.
Asha (Support): I can set the enablement call. Tue 10am PT works? I'll invite pulsewave-eng + pulsewave-ops. Checklist draft: 1) enable prefix caching, 2) batching, 3) reduce default response length, 4) review model choice.
Sam (SRE): I can add a cache toggle and a short-lived throttle header. Patch to gate cache (will test in staging):
```json
{"route":"/v1/embed","cache_enabled":false,"cache_header":"X-Allow-Cache"}
```
Sam (SRE): will push config behind a feature flag and monitor latency.
Evan (Finance): If we throttle embedding-heavy endpoints by 30%, estimated savings ~28% -> new 30d forecast ~$14k. That closes the gap.
Alex (RevOps): provisional approval to top up commit by $5k for 30d to smooth renewal conversation if needed. :thumbsup:
Lina (CSM): Action items: Asha schedule + invite, Sam deploy cache toggle by EOD, Evan confirm finance top-up, Alex confirm billing provision. I'll draft a short customer-facing note for the QBR. Link to draft: https://redwood.in/internal/qbr-drafts/pulsewave (wip).
Sam (SRE): posting rollout snippet to #eng-oncall once live.
Lina (CSM): Also flagging renewal risk: if spend stays >120% of commit at renewal, mark as "at-risk" in CRM and escalate to AE.
Evan (Finance): noted, tagging for QBR deck and renewal playbook.
BudgetBot: alert rule created -> id=rb-2098765, channel=#customer-success, thresholds=[70,85,100], notify=@Lina (CSM).
Lina (CSM): Good. Please capture any customer feedback in the doc and add short notes to the QBR slide. Quick win: enable prefix caching + one enablement call should reduce immediate burn and buy time for their infra changes. :white_check_mark:
